_readme: Outbound links to the parent site. Buying happens at aragocorminerals.com:
it has the real lead form, the CRM behind it and the sales team. This site
is the catalogue and the proof; every buying action hands off to there.
Nothing here is invented. The paths, the `interest` values, the industry
name and the `document` parameter were all read out of the parent's own
lib/attribution.js), so the deep links land on a form that is already
filled in rather than on a blank one.
What each parameter does on arrival, per lib/lead-form.js:
interest   preselects the journey, which decides the fields shown
industry   preselects the industry select; must match a catalog value
document   free text; the form writes it into details as
'Requesting: <text>', which is how the grade, the SKU or a
utm_*      captured by lib/attribution.js and stored on the lead, so
traffic sent from here is attributable in their CRM
If the parent site ever renames a path or an interest value, change it
here once: tools/build.py renders every link from this file and js/site.js
reads the same values out of the markup.
